Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the discovery call last week — the team found it helpful. We have a handful of engineers (platform + infra) who want a deeper look at how Redwood would sit in our OTT ingestion pipeline — specifically:

- model routing & fallback behavior when GPUs are constrained
- KV cache warmup and cold-start behavior for long-context workloads
- options for private deployment into our VPC (networking and KMS flow)

Could we schedule a 60–75 minute technical walkthrough next week that includes one of your runtime engineers? Our preferred times are: Tue Jul 27 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed Jul 28 13:00–16:00 PT.

I've attached the discovery notes and our integration checklist for context.

Thanks,

QuantaScale

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 09:05 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Markus — can you lock Wed Jul 28 at 14:00 PT?

Hi all — confirmed from infra side, I'll cover the networking & firewall bits. Quick preview notes I can share in the session:
- Private deploy uses mTLS over TCP for control-plane connections; model runtime traffic (gRPC) typically runs over TCP but we support TLS-terminated proxies.
- Required outbound ports: 443 (control plane), 50051 (gRPC default) — we'll provide exact port ranges for tenant subnets in advance.
- For UDP-based edge proxies we recommend a TCP proxy hop for model RPCs; we can sketch a small NAT/translation pattern during the call.

I'll bring a short slide with block diagrams and a sample iptables/sg rule set.

—Karthik
